summary:
Results-driven Senior Software Developer with 9+ years of expertise in leading enterprise backend architecture and development teams. Proven track record of delivering high-performance, scalable backend solutions in fintech and enterprise systems while mentoring and leading development teams. Holds a Bachelor's degree in Management Information Systems, combining technical expertise with business acumen for effective team leadership and strategic decision-making. Core competencies include:

• Technical Leadership: Led and mentored backend development teams of 8+ developers, driving innovation, best practices, and achieving 95% sprint completion rates
• Back-End Architecture: Expert in Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud), Microservices Architecture, Distributed Systems Design
• System Design: RESTful APIs, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, Enterprise Integration Patterns, Event-Driven Architecture
• Database Engineering: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Oracle, MySQL, Redis with advanced performance tuning and optimization
• DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, CI/CD automation, Monitoring and Analytics
• Security & Compliance: PCI-DSS compliant systems, secure payment processing, authentication and authorization
• Team Management: Cross-functional collaboration, code reviews, technical mentoring, architecture decisions
• Business Acumen: Management Information Systems background enabling effective alignment of technical solutions with business objectives

Key Achievements:
• Led backend architecture and development team for payment processing platform handling $100M+ annual transactions with 99.99% uptime
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to reduce system response time by 45% through microservices implementation
• Led and mentored teams of 8+ backend developers, achieving 95% sprint completion rate and fostering technical growth
• Improved backend application performance by 60% through technical optimization and coding best practices
• Implemented automated CI/CD pipelines reducing deployment time from 2 hours to 15 minutes
• Established coding standards, best practices, and architectural patterns across backend teams
